Title: NIKKE launcher k2f-agent - domain
Description: Attacker domain that hosted the k2f-agent delivery server. Registered 27 September 2026, about five weeks before the attacks; the Icelandic host was taken down. Source: Bitdefender Labs – Attackers turn NIKKE's game launcher into malware https://www.bitdefender.com/en-us/blog/labs/nikke-game-launcher-malware
RecommendedActions: Block at the perimeter and search 90 days of proxy, DNS and firewall logs for connections.
